subject: 英语
source: 人教版PEP小学英语（三年级起点）教材单元话题整理
original_text:
【核心词汇】cleaned my room 打扫房间; washed my clothes 洗衣服; stayed at home 待在家; watched TV 看电视; read a book 读书; saw a film 看电影; had a cold 感冒
【重点句型】What did you do last weekend? 上周末你做了什么？ I ... 我……了。 Did you ...? 你……了吗？ Yes, I did. / No, I didn't. 是的。/ 没有。 I want to ... 我想……
【A Let's talk】Wu Yifan: What did you do last weekend? Sarah: I cleaned my room and washed my clothes. Wu Yifan: Did you watch TV? Sarah: No, I didn't. I had a cold.
【Read and write】Last weekend was busy. On Saturday morning I cleaned my room. In the afternoon I washed my clothes. In the evening I watched TV. On Sunday I read a book and saw a film. My brother stayed at home and had a cold.
key_points: What did you do last weekend? 上周末你做了什么？
Yes, I did. / No, I didn't. 是的。/ 没有。
cautions: 只做内容骨架（核心词汇、重点句型、对话与短文范例），不生成老师逐字讲解稿；词汇与句型均依据该 PEP 单元目标语言整理，不得编造教材未出现的单词、语法点或例句。
